summary: Latency-sensitive smoke test of new file-management surface: append-only sources bug fix, load-demo button, DEMO badges, preview modal, per-file download. All backend and frontend checks passed.
passed: POST /api/session/load-demo returns 3 demo files (is_demo=true) on first call
POST /api/session/load-demo is idempotent - second call still returns 3 files (no duplicates)
POST /api/upload with existing demo session appends user file - response has 4 files (3 demo is_demo=true + 1 user is_demo=false)
POST /api/session/load-demo after upload keeps user file and does not duplicate demo files (stays 4)
DELETE /api/file/<sid>/<demo-fid> removes only that specific demo file (goes from 4 -> 3, user file preserved)
POST /api/session/load-demo after delete re-adds only missing demo file (back to 4)
GET /api/file/<sid>/<fid>/content returns id, filename, source_type, source_label, is_demo, content, uploaded_at for demo files
GET /api/file/<sid>/<fid>/download returns 200 with Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="brightline_crm_note.txt" and correct bytes for both demo and user files
Frontend: 'Try with demo files' button (data-testid=load-demo-button) visible on first load AND after user upload
Frontend: 3 demo-badge-* pills render on demo file rows; user file row has no demo badge
Frontend: Clicking a file row opens file-preview-modal with file-preview-content (monospace), file-preview-download, file-preview-close; close button dismisses modal
Frontend: After uploading a user file, source count shows 4 (3 demo badges preserved + 1 user file without badge)
No console errors during frontend interaction
